3.name: third person
3.plain: anyone or anything else: he, she, it, they

PRS.name: present
PRS.plain: happening now, or the tense-neutral form of a participle or infinitive

NOM.name: nominative
NOM.plain: the case of the doer, and of what a thing is said to be

ACC.name: accusative
ACC.plain: the case of the thing acted on, and of the goal of motion

Q.name: question particle
Q.plain: a small word that turns a statement into a question

GEN.name: genitive
GEN.plain: the case that hangs one noun on another: of, 's

DAT.name: dative
DAT.plain: the case of the person concerned: to, for

ABL.name: ablative
ABL.plain: the case of source, tool and setting: from, with, in, by

VOC.name: vocative
VOC.plain: the form used to call or address someone

LOC.name: locative
LOC.plain: a rare case meaning at a place

REFL.name: reflexive
REFL.plain: refers back to the subject: himself, herself, themselves

INF.name: infinitive
INF.plain: the form that names the action: to love

IPFV.name: imperfect
IPFV.plain: a past action seen as going on or repeated

PLUP.name: pluperfect
PLUP.plain: an action complete before another past moment: had loved

FUTP.name: future perfect
FUTP.plain: an action that will be complete before a future moment: will have loved

PASS.name: passive
PASS.plain: the subject undergoes the action instead of doing it

PTCP.name: participle
PTCP.plain: an adjective made from a verb

DEP.name: deponent
DEP.plain: a passive ending on a verb whose meaning is active

SBJV.name: subjunctive
SBJV.plain: the mood of what is wished, intended or imagined, not stated as fact

ADV.name: adverb ending
ADV.plain: turns an adjective into a word describing how

REL.name: relative
REL.plain: the word that opens a clause describing a noun: who, which

GER.name: gerund
GER.plain: a noun made from a verb: loving

GERV.name: gerundive
GERV.plain: an adjective made from a verb meaning needing to be done

SUP.name: supine
SUP.plain: a fossil verbal noun in -um or -ū

terms.ending: The final, changeable piece of a word that says what job it is doing (lat-00-02).
terms.stem: The part of a word that stays the same while the ending changes (lat-00-02).
terms.gloss: The line under an example that labels each piece of each word (lat-00-02).
terms.fusional: Built so that one ending carries several meanings at once (lat-00-02).
terms.restored pronunciation: The pronunciation of educated Romans of the classical period, reconstructed from ancient evidence (lat-01-01).
terms.macron: A bar over a vowel marking it as long: ā (lat-01-01).
terms.diphthong: Two vowel sounds glided together inside one syllable, as in ae and au (lat-01-02).
terms.stop: A consonant made by blocking the air completely and releasing it: p, t, c, b, d, g (lat-01-03).
terms.syllable: A beat of a word, built round one vowel or diphthong (lat-01-03).
terms.light syllable: A syllable with a short vowel that is not closed by a consonant (lat-01-03).
terms.heavy syllable: A syllable with a long vowel or diphthong, or closed by a consonant (lat-01-03).
terms.stress: The extra force that makes one syllable of a word stand out (lat-01-04).
terms.penult: The second-from-last syllable of a word (lat-01-04).
terms.antepenult: The third-from-last syllable of a word (lat-01-04).
terms.orthography: A language's spelling system and conventions (lat-01-05).
terms.apex: A mark Romans sometimes wrote over a long vowel in inscriptions (lat-01-05).
terms.person: Who is acting: the speaker (first), the one spoken to (second), or anyone else (third) (lat-02-01).
terms.number: Whether a word refers to one (singular) or more than one (plural) (lat-02-01).
terms.tense: The form of a verb that places an action in time (lat-02-01).
terms.present tense: The tense for what is happening now or happens generally (lat-02-01).
terms.conjugation: A family of verbs that share one pattern of endings (lat-02-01).
terms.subject: The doer, or the thing the sentence is about (lat-02-02).
terms.agreement: Two words matching in features such as number, gender and case (lat-02-02).
terms.case: The form of a noun that shows its job in the sentence (lat-02-02).
terms.declension: A family of nouns that share one pattern of endings (lat-02-02).
terms.object: The thing or person acted on (lat-02-03).
terms.transitive: Of a verb: taking an object (lat-02-03).
terms.gender: The class a noun belongs to (masculine, feminine, neuter), which decides the endings of words that agree with it (lat-02-04).
terms.natural gender: Gender that follows the sex of a person or animal (lat-02-04).
terms.grammatical gender: Gender as a class of words, regardless of sex (lat-02-04).
terms.predicate noun: A noun that says what the subject is, after a verb like 'be' (lat-02-05).
terms.negation: Making a sentence say that something is not so (lat-02-06).
terms.enclitic: A small word that leans on the word before it and is written joined to it, like -ne and -que (lat-02-06).
terms.question particle: A small word that turns a statement into a question (lat-02-06).
terms.adjective: A word that describes a noun (lat-02-07).
terms.attributive: Of an adjective: attached directly to a noun, as in 'the good girl' (lat-02-07).
terms.predicate adjective: An adjective that says what the subject is, after a verb like 'be' (lat-02-07).
terms.chiasmus: A crossed arrangement of words in the pattern A B B A (lat-02-08).
terms.preposition: A small word placed before a noun to show place, direction or relation, such as in, ad, cum (lat-03-04).
terms.rhotacism: The change of s to r between vowels in early Latin, which explains pairs like corpus, corporis (lat-03-07).
terms.i-stem: A third-declension noun whose stem once ended in i, which shows in endings such as genitive plural -ium (lat-03-08).
terms.parisyllabic: Having the same number of syllables in the nominative and genitive singular, as cīvis, cīvis (lat-03-08).
terms.vocative: The form used to call or address someone (lat-03-06).
terms.pronoun: A word that stands in for a noun: I, you, he (lat-03-10).
terms.reflexive: Referring back to the subject of its clause: himself, herself, themselves (lat-03-10).
terms.locative: A rare case meaning 'at' a place, used with names of towns and a few other nouns (lat-03-01; fully in lat-03-13).
